hints.title: Move
hints.text: Traverse streets, markets, and open ground.

hints.title: Look around
hints.text: Survey your surroundings and keep sight of approaching fighters.

hints.title: Sprint
hints.text: Sprint across open ground to close distance against ranged opponents.

hints.title: Jump and rise
hints.text: Leap over obstacles. Tap again while airborne to rise higher.

hints.title: Light strike
hints.text: Deliver quick strikes with weapon or bare fists to open combat.

hints.title: Heavy strike
hints.text: Break through enemy defenses with heavy attacks. Slower to wind up, harder to stop.

hints.title: Guard
hints.text: Raise your guard to absorb the force of incoming blows.

hints.title: Parry
hints.text: Raise guard within 0.15 seconds of an impact to deflect the blow and stagger the attacker.

hints.title: Dodge
hints.text: Evade incoming swings with brief invulnerability during the roll.

hints.title: Lock target
hints.text: Focus your camera and attacks onto a single opponent.

hints.title: Toggle bending
hints.text: Ignite elemental power to imbue strikes or sheath it to move unnoticed.

hints.title: Rising attack
hints.text: Launch opponents skyward with an elemental uppercut.

hints.title: Ground slam
hints.text: Slam downward to shake the earth and destabilize surrounding enemies.

hints.title: Ultimate power
hints.text: Unleash your nation's signature elemental storm once combat reaches its peak.

hints.title: Switch fighting stance
hints.text: Alternate between armed weapons, bare-fisted brawling, and kicking styles.

hints.title: Open satchel
hints.text: Check your carried coin, gathered materials, and crafted gear.

hints.title: Interact and claim
hints.text: Talk to townsfolk, bargain with merchants, and gather dropped loot from the cobblestones.

hints.title: Shard spark
hints.text: As the Hush, fling shard fragments to strike foes from range.

hints.title: The rising
hints.text: You don't choose what you become. The world decides as you rise: Shaper or Hush.

hints.title: The Shapers
hints.text: Born with elemental fire, water, earth, or wind. They fight on the frontline and channel raw forces.

hints.title: The Hush
hints.text: Born without an element. Derided as the Dim, they alone hold the skill to smelt ore, tan hide, and craft weapons from raw goods.

hints.title: Rumours of the Allborn
hints.text: Whispers speak of an Allborn who commands all four elements and knows how to break out of this world.

hints.title: The nation of Ignis
hints.text: A volcanic fortress of black iron and ember-lit streets. Ambitious, unyielding, and at war with all neighbours.

hints.title: The delta of Aques
hints.text: Canals, waterways, and timber houses on stilts. Travelers journey to its pools to recuperate and heal.

hints.title: The canyon of Terra
hints.text: A canyon fortress hewn directly from ochre cliffs. The wealthiest territory outside Chromara.

hints.title: The towers of Aura
hints.text: Tall stone spires and rope bridges high above the clouds. Aloof and peaceable toward outsiders.

hints.title: The Edict
hints.text: The ruling power abolished the true names of the elements to fracture the nations and weaken their masters.

hints.title: The city of Chromara
hints.text: The seat of authority spans the center of the world, housing the Great Treasury and the Lord's garrisons.

hints.title: The Lord's Sentries
hints.text: Heavily armoured peacekeepers enforce order across the plazas. Violating local laws invites swift confiscation.

hints.title: Beasts of the wild
hints.text: Nameless elemental currents coalesce in untamed lands, spawning ember hounds and river serpents.

hints.title: The combo meter
hints.text: Landing hits, parrying attacks, and guarding blows fills your combat meter. It slowly drains between clashes.

hints.title: Faded strikes
hints.text: When meter drops below 25, bending attacks deal only 60% damage and elemental hazards dissipate quickly.

hints.title: Chained moves
hints.text: With meter above 25, chaining one bending move into another cancels cooldowns and increases damage.

hints.title: Ignis burns
hints.text: Fire attacks leave targets ablaze, dealing continuous damage after the initial strike.

hints.title: Aques shatter
hints.text: Water moves slow enemies and freeze ground. Hitting a frozen target shatters the ice for bonus damage.

hints.title: Terra stone walls
hints.text: Raising an earth wall creates an impenetrable barrier that halts projectile barrages and advancing foes.

hints.title: Aura gale blades
hints.text: Air blades slice through multiple enemies in a single stroke, piercing ranks of attackers.

hints.title: The finishing blow
hints.text: Striking down the final opponent in a skirmish slows time to survey the battlefield.

hints.title: Watch standing and fines
hints.text: Street brawling and theft raise red flags with the watch. If fines go unpaid, you face arrest and seizure of carried goods.

hints.title: Street challengers
hints.text: Wandering duelists test their skills in town. Stand before a challenger to initiate single combat.

hints.title: Crowd reactions
hints.text: Townsfolk retreat to doorways and stalls when blades are drawn, returning only after peace is restored.

hints.title: The shrine
hints.text: If you fall in combat, you awaken at your nation's local shrine. Any materials carried in your hands remain at the site of your fall.

hints.title: Ground drops
hints.text: Defeated outlaws drop coin and shards onto the flagstones. Walk over each drop to collect it into your pouch.

hints.title: Counting houses
hints.text: Visit Sindr's counting houses to bank coin securely beyond the reach of footpads and corrupt bailiffs.

hints.title: Night curfew
hints.text: After dark, shops bolt their shutters and guards draw closer to lit braziers. Deserted alleys attract desperate outlaws.

hints.title: Fists and bending
hints.text: Shapers channel stronger elemental surges when fighting bare-handed than when holding forged steel.
